title: Responsive card grid with clickable cards
when: The user wants a grid of cards for articles, products, services or team members that adapts to any width.
inputs: the items with image, title, text and link
prompt:
Goal: A fluid grid of equal height cards where the whole card is clickable through one real link.
Steps:
1. <ul class="cards"> of <li><article> with an img (alt, width, height, aspect-ratio: 16 / 9, object-fit: cover), an h3 with the one link, a short paragraph and meta.
2. Grid: grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(16rem, 1fr)) with a gap of 1.5rem.
3. Whole card click: the heading link gets ::after with position: absolute; inset: 0, the article is position: relative; secondary links sit above with z-index.
4. Equal heights: the article is display: flex with flex-direction: column, and the meta row uses margin-top: auto.
5. Images after the first row get loading="lazy"; show focus with .card:focus-within.
Quality bar:
- Titles clamp at two lines, text at three.
- Every card has the same parts in the same order.
- Hover and focus look the same.
Pitfalls:
- Wrapping the whole card in a link, which makes screen readers read everything as one link.
- Cards of different heights in one row.
- Images without dimensions shifting the grid.
Verify:
- [ ] Each card has one link with clear text.
- [ ] Images have alt, width and height.
- [ ] One column at 375 px.
- [ ] Focus shows on the whole card.
Output: Grid markup, cards.css, and a render script only when cards come from data.

examples.input: grade de cards dos servicos com imagem e link
examples.output: auto-fill grid of six article cards, stretched heading link, equal heights, focus-within outline
